prior_deficiency: The datasets submitted do not include a Unique Subject ID (USUBJID) consistent across all domains, preventing cross-dataset comparison.
prior_response_summary: Applicant resubmitted all SDTM domains with a harmonized USUBJID derived from the enrollment system, added a cross-reference table in the define.xml mapping legacy subject identifiers to USUBJID, and confirmed CDISC SDTM v3.2 conformance via Pinnacle 21 validation report.
outcome: Deficiency closed on resubmission; no further CRL comments on this point.

prior_deficiency: Case narratives for serious adverse events were inconsistent with the case report forms and omitted causality assessments.
prior_response_summary: Applicant re-wrote all SAE/AEOSI narratives using the standard CIOMS-aligned template (event description, onset/outcome, concomitant medications, investigator and sponsor causality assessment) and cross-checked each narrative line-by-line against the source CRFs, documenting QC sign-off.
outcome: FDA accepted the revised narratives without further query.

prior_deficiency: Submitted datasets used the .sas7bdat proprietary format instead of the required SAS XPORT transport format.
prior_response_summary: Applicant regenerated and resubmitted all datasets as non-compressed .xpt (SAS Transport v5), re-ran Pinnacle 21 compliance checks, and provided a transmittal letter confirming file-format and encoding (Western/latin1) conformance.
outcome: Resolved; FDA confirmed the resubmitted datasets were reviewable.
